subject: missing_credentials although we send the header
body: Our client sends Authorization: Bearer with a fresh token, but we get 401 with error.code missing_credentials. The request goes through our outbound proxy, which first calls http://api.fernwick.example and follows a redirect to https.
allowed_facts: missing_credentials means the Authorization header was not sent
proxies that strip the Authorization header on redirects are a common cause

subject: Tokens rejected long before they should expire
body: Our tokens are rejected with 401 token_expired only 50 minutes after we got them, sometimes sooner. Our server time is set manually and we noticed it is 8 minutes ahead of UTC.
allowed_facts: Fernwick validates expiry against its own clock
servers more than 5 minutes off UTC can see this

subject: Sometimes 401, sometimes 403 when creating invoices
body: Creating invoices fails now and then with 401 or 403, we are not sure which one. It works most of the time.
allowed_facts: 401 means not authenticated, 403 means authenticated but not allowed

subject: 403 workspace_mismatch on GET invoice
body: We manage two workspaces. GET /v1/invoices/inv_55Pq returns 403 with error.code workspace_mismatch. The key works for other invoices.
allowed_facts: workspace_mismatch means the key belongs to a different workspace than the resource

subject: Will more API keys give us more throughput?
body: We hit 429 at about 100 requests per second. If we create five more API keys and spread the traffic across them, will that raise our throughput?
allowed_facts: limits apply per workspace, not per key
more keys do not raise the limit
Standard plan is 100 requests per second

subject: Duplicate invoices after 429 retries
body: When POST /v1/invoices returns 429 our client waits and retries. Sometimes we end up with two identical invoices. How can we avoid duplicates?
allowed_facts: send an Idempotency-Key header on POST requests

subject: Webhook endpoint was disabled, need old events
body: Our receiver was down for four days and we got an email that the endpoint was disabled. We re-enabled it yesterday but the events from the outage never came. How do we get them?
allowed_facts: endpoints failing for 72 hours are disabled
re-enabling does not resend old events
events from the last 30 days can be replayed from the delivery log or POST /v1/webhook_events/{event_id}/replay

subject: New invoice.voided events are not delivered
body: We get invoice.paid and invoice.created webhooks fine, but we never receive the new invoice.voided events that were announced last month.
allowed_facts: new event types are not added to existing endpoints automatically
subscribe the endpoint to the event type in Dashboard > Developers > Webhooks

subject: Export very slow, when will it finish?
body: Our export is very slow today. When will it be done? We need the file for a board meeting.

subject: Our live API key was pushed to a public GitHub repo
body: A developer accidentally committed our fw_live_ key to a public repository two hours ago. We see invoices we did not create. What should we do?

subject: Do you plan a GraphQL API?
body: We would prefer GraphQL over REST for our mobile app. Is a GraphQL endpoint on your roadmap, and can we join a beta?

subject: All requests return 500 for every customer we know
body: Since 11:20 UTC every request returns 500 Internal Server Error. Two other companies in our partner network see the same. Is Fernwick down?
